name: Pulsarr
description: Pulsarr is a real-time Plex watchlist monitoring, routing, and notification center that bridges Plex watchlists with Sonarr and Radarr. Features include smart content routing, approval workflows with quota management, Discord bot integration, multi-user support, and comprehensive analytics - all automated from within the Plex App itself.

paths.name: App Data Path
paths.description: Path for configuration files, database, and logs

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: Port to access the web UI

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID the container runs as

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID the container runs as

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: Timezone in TZ format (e.g., America/New_York, Europe/London)

variables.name: Secure Cookies
variables.description: Set to true if accessing Pulsarr through HTTPS (reverse proxy)

variables.name: Base Path
variables.description: URL subpath when behind a reverse proxy (e.g., /pulsarr)

variables.name: Authentication Method
variables.description: Authentication mode: required, requiredExceptLocal, or disabled

variables.name: Allow Iframes
variables.description: Allow embedding in Organizr, Homarr, Homepage, etc.

variables.name: Apprise API URL
variables.description: Apprise API server URL (e.g., http://apprise:8000). Enables Apprise notifications when set.

variables.name: Enable Request Logging
variables.description: Log all HTTP requests - useful for debugging reverse proxy issues

variables.name: PostgreSQL Connection String
variables.description: Full connection string (e.g., postgres://user:pass@host:5432/pulsarr). Supersedes host, port, database, user, and password options if set.
